licenses_source_check.name: licenses_source_check
licenses_source_check.value: ("licenses"."plan" = 'desktop' and "licenses"."order_id" is not null and "licenses"."subscription_id" is null) or ("licenses"."plan" = 'pro' and "licenses"."subscription_id" is not null and "licenses"."period_start" is not null)

subscriptions_interval_check.name: subscriptions_interval_check
subscriptions_interval_check.value: ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'pro' and "subscriptions"."interval" is not null and "subscriptions"."interval" in ('month', 'year')) or ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'api' and "subscriptions"."interval" is null)
